condition.name: glucose_anaerobic
condition.notes: Glucose uptake 10 mmol gDW^-1 h^-1, oxygen uptake closed. Same condition as the SC-01 succinate example, so the two runs are comparable.

brief:
- The published targets for succinate in anaerobic E. coli are ldhA, pflB, ptsG and the acetate branch (pta/ackA).
- Growth has to stay above the floor for the strain to be useful at all.
- Succinate through fumarate reductase consumes NADH, so reducing power is the cofactor to watch.
